headline: VULCAN ENERGY CLOSES €2.2B LIONHEART LITHIUM FINANCING — 500,000 EV BATTERIES/YEAR BY 2028
snippet: Vulcan Energy achieved financial close on €2.2B in project financing for its zero-carbon Lionheart lithium hydroxide plant in Germany's Upper Rhine Valley, targeting 24,000 t/y of battery-grade lithium — enough for 500,000 EVs annually — with a 2028 production start and 275 GWh of renewable energy output, a landmark milestone for European critical mineral security.

headline: IRAN WAR TRIGGERS SULPHURIC ACID CRISIS: HALF OF GLOBAL LITHIUM AND NICKEL OUTPUT NOW AT RISK
snippet: Sulphuric acid prices have more than doubled in some regions since the Iran conflict began, with sulphur now representing 42% of HPAL nickel costs — up from 26% pre-war. Benchmark Mineral Intelligence warns more than half of projected 2026 global lithium, cobalt, and rare earth production is exposed to sulphur disruption, as over 10% of global seaborne sulphur trade transits the Strait of Hormuz.

headline: ERIC SPROTT BACKS C$100M RAISE FOR GALANTAS GOLD'S CHILE COPPER-GOLD PUSH
snippet: TSX-V listed Galantas Gold (CVE:GAL) completed a C$100M private placement at $0.55/unit backed by Eric Sprott, Ocean Partners and Melquart, to advance the Indiana gold-copper and Andacollo gold projects in Chile — targeting production by early 2027.

headline: MONUMENT MINING'S SELINSING DRILL PROGRAM CONFIRMS HIGH-GRADE GOLD EXTENSIONS IN MALAYSIA
snippet: Monument Mining (TSXV:MMY) released assay results from 23 additional drill holes at the Buffalo Reef/Felda areas of its Selinsing gold mine in Malaysia, confirming wide zones of high-grade mineralization that extend the ore body at depth and outside the current Life of Mine pit shell — supporting a meaningful resource addition ahead of full program completion in June.

headline: AZTEC MINERALS EXPANDS TOMBSTONE GOLD-SILVER DRILL PROGRAM TO 22,200M IN ARIZONA
snippet: Aztec Minerals (TSXV:AZT) approved a further 3,500m RC expansion at its Tombstone joint venture in Arizona, bringing the total combined program to approximately 22,200m — the new Northern Contention Area targets shallow oxide gold-silver mineralization and drilling is expected to run through August 2026.

headline: SUNSHINE SILVER EYES $2.32B NYSE LISTING — $330M IPO TO RESTART IDAHO SILVER-ANTIMONY MINE
snippet: Sunshine Silver Mining & Refining (NYSE:SSMR) is pricing its IPO at $13.50–$16.50/share to raise up to $330M at a $2.32B valuation, backed by Pierre Lassonde's Electrum Group, to fund the restart of the historic Coeur d'Alene district silver and antimony mine in Idaho — with Morgan Stanley, Scotiabank, and BMO as lead bookrunners.

headline: CONGO BANS MINING IN SOUTH KIVU FOR 3 MONTHS — GOLD AND COLTAN BELT HIT BY ANTI-FRAUD CRACKDOWN
snippet: The DRC Ministry of Mines imposed a three-month suspension of all mining across South Kivu's Mwenga and Shabunda territories on May 22, covering gold, cassiterite, and coltan — escalating a crackdown on illicit extraction and documented links between conflict minerals and armed group financing.

headline: GOLD ETF INFLOWS TURN POSITIVE FOR FIRST TIME SINCE APRIL — HORMUZ CLOSURE ADDS STRUCTURAL FLOOR
snippet: Net gold ETF inflows turned positive for the first time since early April — North America contributed $824M and Europe $180M, per BMO data in GoldSeek's Asian Metals Market Update. Gold has fallen roughly 15% since the Iran conflict erupted, but analysts note the longer the Strait of Hormuz stays closed, the more structurally supportive the environment, as elevated energy prices push central banks toward a higher-for-longer stance.

headline: RICK RULE: "GLAD TO SEE GOLD ON SALE" — SOLIDLY BULLISH ON URANIUM AS JAPAN RESTARTS ACCELERATE
snippet: At the Rule Symposium in Florida (May 25), veteran resource investor Rick Rule called gold's pullback a buying opportunity — precious metals represent just 0.5% of U.S. savings vs. a 40-year mean of 2%. On uranium, Rule is 'solidly bullish,' citing Japanese reactor restarts as the necessary precondition for higher prices: 'That's something that's happening now, not in the future.'
